items.title: Reddit 将切换为“仅限登录体验”
items.summary: The exact details of the change are still being determined (and yep, this is about AI).

content.v: Reddit will become a "logged-in only experience," and the company plans to move fast, beginning testing soon in regions outside the US before flipping the switch globally.

The popular community website—home to a great many official and unofficial gaming message boards—lost one million search engine referrals per week on average in October, CEO Steve Huffman said on an investor call today .

The culprit, of course, was AI. A Google search that once might have led someone to a 14-year-old Reddit thread containing the answer to a rare household cleaning problem is now likely to present that answer in an AI summary, no click required.
"Google has really shifted in their relationship with the rest of the internet," Huffman said during a Q&A.

The CEO emphasized, however, that most of Reddit's revenue (over 80%) comes from logged-in and app users, and said that the company will focus on establishing the site as "a direct daily habit" that doesn't rely on search traffic.

Efforts cited in that direction include algorithmic feeds, improved app design and performance, AI-powered moderation tools, and "new experiences like games and visual podcasts," the latter referring to, I believe, a feature that uses generative AI to turn posts into videos .
The switch to a logged-in only experience will also help "protect access to Reddit's extremely valuable corpus of data," Huffman said.

Reddit currently has AI training arrangements with OpenAI and Google. In the Q&A portion of the call, Huffman said that Reddit has nothing to announce about those deals, but that it is in "active discussions" and that its leadership will "do what makes sense and is in the best interest for Reddit strategically and economically."

Although it reported 53% year-over-year revenue growth in its 2026 third-quarter results, as well as 16% growth in weekly active users, Reddit's share price dropped today due to a lower-than-expected forecast for the next quarter.

items.title: 《使命召唤：现代战争 4》在万圣节主题内容中添加“非 MilSim 内容”免责声明
items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has added new disclaimers to content that may not abide by the game's usual gro

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/28/codmw4thumb-1793203710340.png
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has added new disclaimers to content that may not abide by the game's usual grounded tone and aesthetic.

Earlier today, Modern Warfare 4 added a new mode known as Possession. It's a Halloween-themed mode that lets players "possess" the person they last killed, allowing you to both teleport to their last location and take their loadout. It's a really interesting idea for a mode, but of course, it doesn't adhere to the game's grounded, gritty, and more realistic tone. So, Infinity Ward added a "non-milsim content" disclaimer tag to the playlist before players search for a match.
The new Possession MP mode added to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 includes a warning: "Warning: Non-MilSim Content" The new mode is a Halloween themed MP mode https://t.co/STQSgd4jpZ

This comes after years of players getting frustrated that Call of Duty's multiplayer often abandons the darker, more serious tone established by the campaign and seasonal lore drops. The franchise has added skins that allow players to play as Nicki Minaj, Beavis and Butthead, and Seth Rogen, which has come at the cost of the game's identity. Infinity Ward already promised to dial things back with Modern Warfare 4 and not include absurd, over-the-top skins, but this new disclaimer does suggest there will be some content that may ride a line for hardcore fans.

Of course, you can also make the argument that Call of Duty isn't realistic and it isn't really a "milsim" game, since it's so fast-paced and filled with ridiculous movement, Wolverine-style health regeneration, and more. It's more of an aesthetic than a style of play. Still, some players value the immersion of more realistic military characters and modes and don't want that disrupted.

It's unclear what Infinity Ward's plans are for bundles in the future, but the team recently outlined its plans for Modern Warfare 4 Season 1, and a lot of it seems to retain the grounded tone that fans desire. Of course, we'll have to wait and see what's in store in the new year, which is often when we start to see more crossover content.

items.title: 《战争机器：E-Day》据报道在第一天游戏通行证推出后一个月在主机和 PC 上售出超过 40 万份
items.summary: Sources tell The Verge that Gears of War: E-Day has sold over 400,000 copies across console and PC, and Game P

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/07/gears-of-war-e-day-xbox-console-exclusive-1780874341784.png
Sources tell The Verge that Gears of War: E-Day has sold over 400,000 copies across console and PC, and Game Pass is likely to blame.

The latest entry in the Gears franchise released to critical acclaim earlier this month, drawing high scores from reviewers and fans alike. (IGN scored the game a 9 out of 10 , saying its “stellar story campaign is complemented by an excellent multiplayer suite.”)

However, it seems the title’s popularity isn’t translating to sales — at least, that’s according to a new figure reported by The Verge . Correspondent Tom Warren cited a source who estimated that 400,000 copies of the game have been sold in total across consoles and PC, which paints a grim figure considering the prestige of this particular release.

Many are pointing to Xbox Game Pass as the reason for this surprisingly low figure. The game was a day-one release on the service, and was available for early access five days before its official launch via a $30 Premium Edition Upgrade, meaning that total units sold are most certainly lower than those who accessed the title through Game Pass. (It’s also worth noting that most players were under the impression this would be a multiplatform release until Xbox revealed it as a console exclusive just four months before launch.)

Data from Alinea Analytics appears to corroborate this thought. As laid out in an October 9 post from the research firm’s head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, an estimated 1.7 million players accessed E-Day using their Game Pass subscription, rather than buying a copy.

Elliott figured that of those 1.7 million players, likely 722,000 paid for the Premium upgrade, with the game prompting an additional 250,000 Premium upgrades between October 1 and the game’s full release on October 6.

As told by Elliott at the time of his post, “E-Day sold 62,000 copies on Xbox against 722,000 Premium upgrades, so for every one copy sold on Xbox, nearly 12 Game Pass upgrades were sold.” He surmised that Xbox accounted for nearly three-quarters of the game’s total revenue, but said that despite these seemingly low numbers, nearly 950K likely paid for the game in some way — just not by outright purchasing an actual copy.

These E-Day figures follow news that Xbox Game Pass might be receiving a major overhaul that could let subscribers pick which features they want to actually pay for. As told by Fortune , this would include "add-ons for console-only games, cloud gaming, and multiplayer, with the system operating on a tiered structure, according to people familiar with the strategy."

It’s a turbulent time for Xbox, which is still in the midst of a massive restructuring . A total of 3,200 employees are expected to lose their jobs at the company, as told by CEO Asha Sharma this summer. This restructuring has also resulted in the divestment of several game studios, including Arkane Lyon, who now has until December 13, 2026 to find a buyer and save its highly-anticipated Blade game .

items.title: Bethesda Pays Tribute to Patrick Stewart for His Role in Oblivion, Fans Remember His Role in Games Like Castlevania
items.summary: Bethesda has paid tribute to Sir Patrick Stewart for his role in The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion after his death

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/hv06502wmaayufx-1793310464924.jpeg
Bethesda has paid tribute to Sir Patrick Stewart for his role in The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion after his death.

Earlier today, it was announced that beloved actor Sir Patrick Stewart, best known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men, died at 86 years old . The news came as a shock to many, and social media has been full of tributes to the actor. Many of his longtime collaborators, such as William Shatner, Kevin Feige, and Hugh Jackman all shared kind words about their time working with him.

Bethesda also offered up its own tribute by acknowledging the actor's death, calling him an "inspiration to us all." Stewart had a brief role in The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion as Emperor Uriel Septim VII, who is killed off at the very beginning of the game. Despite having minimal screen time, his character is the one who introduces you to the world of Cyrodiil and the looming threats that you will contend with.
Rest in peace to Sir Patrick Stewart — an emperor, a captain, and an inspiration to us all. Our thoughts are with his loved ones. https://t.co/dDzYWyDpV3

Despite having less than 10 minutes of screen time in the game, Bethesda put together a massive, overly-detailed document (reportedly as long as 90 pages) about the history and details of the Emperor. They thought that maybe they'd gone too far and worried that Stewart would ignore all of it, but executive producer Todd Howard stated that the actor was thrilled with the depth they had given the character and was excited to play him.

In a behind-the-scenes documentary about the making of Oblivion, developers gathered around in a room to listen to Stewart's first recordings for the game, gushing over how well he performed lines, some of which they feared would be cheesy. One developer was so enamored by Stewart's career that he carried around a picture of the actor in his wallet.
Fans of the game rallied on social media, saying that the actor was the perfect person to introduce players to the world in Oblivion.
"The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion would not have hit the same without the iconic introduction and prologue led by Patrick Stewart as Emperor Uriel Septim VII," said one fan .

"Despite only being in the game for the opening and tutorial, Patrick Stewart gave the intro of Oblivion immense gravitas that will never be forgotten and could not have been achieved my anyone else," echoed another .

Stewart had a pretty notable career in the video game industry outside of Oblivion. He reprised his Star Trek and X-Men characters for various video games over the years, but also did some pretty impactful voice work for games like Castlevania: Lords of Shadow.
Patrick Stewart's narration in Castlevania: Lords of Shadow Such an iconic voice https://t.co/9f0bxgOr6S
Stewart's family has encouraged fans and friends to donate to the Johns Hopkins Alzheimer’s Disease Research Center Fund and the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America Caregiver Resources.

items.title: BioWare 联合创始人 Greg Zeschuk 在谈到游戏行业高管时表示：“这些人都没有制作过游戏，他们只是不知道游戏是如何运作的”
items.summary: In a rare interview, Zeschuk said the closure of BioWare is sad, but his greater concern is for the people put

content.v: It's been almost 15 years since BioWare co-founders Greg Zeschuk and Ray Muzyka announced their retirements from the videogame industry, and they've been resolute about staying out of it ever since: Muzyka continues to head up the ThresholdImpact investment firm he founded in 2012 and holds multiple roles at the University of Alberta, while Zeschuk owns Blind Enthusiasm Brewing Company , also based in Alberta, where he works with a small handful of other BioWare veterans.

But Zeschuk stepped back into the videogame spotlight, briefly, following last week's closure of BioWare by parent company Electronic Arts, telling 80lv that he got the news hours after it happened because he was on a fishing trip, and by the time he flew home a couple days later, he'd "already shelved it away."

"I wasn't there to share in the moment, which in some ways was nice because I was able to kind of just take my time with it," Zeschuk said. "I’m not saying it doesn't hurt and doesn't suck. And I think it's kind of sad. It's actually, in some ways, saddest for the city of Edmonton, where we're from, because we were kind of this beacon of hope and excitement and possibility. We showed you could do something really special in a place that was not known for doing things like that."

Zeschuk said he had his own "emotional moment" about BioWare years ago, when he left the company; his real concern now is for the people at the studio who now find themselves out of work: "Anyone getting put into the job hunt is a sort of terrifying endeavor and super sad."

He also said he has no regrets about the EA acquisition, saying it offered "stability" as the studio continued to grow and that "we saw there'd be value in being part of something bigger rather than going our own way and taking all the risks." At the same time, he had a feeling when EA was acquired by Saudi Arabia's PIF that it probably wouldn't go well for BioWare, because it doesn't fit into the guns-and-sports model: "BioWare makes these kind of unusual games that take a long time and they're complicated and so it's easier just to pump out sports games every year and that's a better business model in some ways."

Zeschuk was also critical of the idea, seen in the recent wave of studio mergers and AI-powered cutbacks, "that you can just kind of recreate great games with random people and AI. It doesn't work," Zeschuk said.

"The other harsh reality of almost all these companies, the people that go down the business track never really come from the development track. Because none of these people have ever made a game, like, never really sat and made one, like, from start to finish, even a small thing, they just don't know how it works."

Zeschuk does know how it works, and he was clear that he's not interested in going back. "For me it was time to go, and I kind of walked out of the games business without any intention of ever returning. I'm happy being a consumer and playing games," he said. "I have my opinions on how to make stuff, but as enticing as it would be, it's just not [worth] the personal struggle and cost and effort required to make a great game. Having gone through the crucible of game development, I'm not going back in there."

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793309292_539786_jpg_r.jpg
R星联合工作室负责人Aaron Garbut介绍，相比《给他爱5》主要以晴天、雨天等整体状态呈现天气，新作采用了更细致的系统。玩家所在位置可能阳光充足，同时看见远处正在形成或移动的风暴；随着玩家靠近，周边环境也会逐渐变化，而非全地图统一切换天气。
天气突变时，人群会四散寻找遮蔽。风力除了作用于树木，也会改变云层和海面波浪。岛屿及建筑还能为部分水域挡风，因此船只在不同位置可能平稳驶过水面，也可能受到风浪明显摇晃，具体状况会受周围地形和建筑分布影响。
空中载具也会与风暴互动。飞机进入风暴后将遭遇湍流，长时间停留还可能受到轻微损伤。Garbut表示，这些表现来自多个细粒度系统之间的相互作用。

content.v: 开发商Alkimia已为《 哥特王朝：重制版 》推出首个功能更新。此次更新加入拍照模式和Marvin模式，同时扩充常规玩法并修复多项问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793308891_833545_jpg_r.jpg
玩家可以从暂停菜单进入拍照模式，也能按L键快速启动，通过相关工具记录游戏世界中的画面。Alkimia此前已于8月公布这项功能。
Marvin模式相当于官方作弊模式。玩家按Esc后输入“MARVIN”，再次按Esc即可启用；关闭时则需按Esc并输入“42”。该模式能够开启难以撬开的锁、传送至其他地点、生成物品，还可生成角色或生物。
常规玩法也得到扩充。加入沼泽营地后，玩家可通过一名营地成员使用更多兄弟会沉浸与自定义选项；坐在长椅上可以使用等待功能，加快游戏内时间。制作武器的属性有所提高，游戏还增加了声音反馈，并为角色受到伤害后死于水中的情况加入专用动画。
本次修复涉及装备、日志、任务和角色行为，包括两枚相同戒指无法正常装备、部分地点及敌人日志无法解锁、水法师长袍重复出售，以及以不同顺序处理“Aaron Chest”任务时可能出现的流程阻断。第四章魔像尸体的交互角度也得到改善。
补丁还为玩家提前取得焦点石时的Lester、Milten和Gorn增加后备处理，修正Urshak在触发寻找兽人萨满任务后未出现在废墟城堡的问题，并调整Mad Kalom在特定情况下的战斗行为、寻路和攻击。
《哥特王朝：重制版》现已登陆PC、PS5和Xbox Series X/S，Alkimia表示下一项目将于2027年公开。

items.title: 热门独立恐怖游戏《漱口》将由《詹妮弗的身体》导演制作真人电影
items.summary: Mouthwashing is getting the Hollywood treatment with a full-length feature film directed by the mind behind Je

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/mouthwashingthumb-1793305960020.png
Mouthwashing is getting the Hollywood treatment with a full-length feature film directed by the mind behind Jennifer's Body.

Critically-acclaimed indie horror game Mouthwashing , developed by Wrong Organ and published by Critical Reflex, is coming to the silver screen. This official announcement follows more than two weeks of rumors about a movie adaptation that have swirled within the game’s fanbase.

Revealed today, October 29, by Wrong Organ and Sony Pictures’ Screen Gems production company, the crew of the Tulpar will soon make their way to a theater near you. Scott Derrickson ( Doctor Strange , The Black Phone ) is set to produce, alongside C. Robert Cargill and Vince Cheng for their Crooked Highway production house.

Karyn Kusama (famous for Jennifer’s Body and Yellowjackets ) is set to direct, with Matt Manfredi and Phil Hay (The Invitation) writing the script. Thus far, exact plot details are unconfirmed — but if you’re familiar with the game, you’ll have a good idea of what you’re in for.

The game follows five crew members manning the Tulpar, a freight ship under the Pony Express shipping company. When the vessel goes off course, its staff must cope with their dire circumstances, battling starvation, isolation, paranoia, and hallucinations — and even defending themselves from their fellow crewmates.

The game has been widely well-received, with IGN scoring the game a glowing 9 out of 10 . First released on PC in 2024, the game is now out on consoles as of today, October 29. Another Critical Reflex joint, No, I’m Not a Human , alongside celebrated indie game Arctic Eggs , are also coming to Xbox, as revealed during the ID@XBOX showcase earlier this month..

Thus far, it’s anyone’s guess as to who’ll get cast in the movie — but given that some of its characters were directly inspired by real-life actors (Shelley Duvall, for one), we’re keen to see who gets picked to join the Tulpar on its doomed journey through space.

This is the latest video game to get greenlit for a screen adaptation after news that PUBG is getting a live-action show on Netflix , which is being written, directed, produced by, and even starring Donald Glover.

It seems like more and more video games are being put on the silver screen; Michael B. Jordan is helming a Battlefield film adaptation , and Capcom’s Street Fighter flick debuted in theaters earlier this month. This follows Zach Cregger’s wildly successful Resident Evil movie , which is the latest in a string of successful horror films that have rocked the box office this year.

items.title: PS5美国同期累计销量领先PS4约1% 2026年销量落后3%
items.summary: PS5上市已进入第71个月。按照各代主机上市后的相同时间节点比较，其在美国的累计销量仍比PS4高约1%，同时比PS3高30%；但只看2026年，PS5销量比PS4相应数据低3%。Circana分析师Mat Piscate

content.v: PS5上市已进入第71个月。按照各代主机上市后的相同时间节点比较，其在美国的累计销量仍比PS4高约1%，同时比PS3高30%；但只看2026年，PS5销量比PS4相应数据低3%。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793307096_787781_jpg_r.jpg
Circana分析师Mat Piscatella提供的这组数据表明，PS5在本世代截至目前仍以微弱优势领先同期PS4。不过，累计表现与2026年的单年走势并不相同，两者需要分开理解。
这项比较还涉及两个世代所处的不同环境。PS5发售初期曾因新冠疫情遭遇严重供应问题，目前硬件价格也明显高于PS4在相近生命周期阶段的水平。资料列出的基础版PS5售价为650美元，PS5 Pro则为900美元。
相比之下，PS4同期曾推出售价200美元的套装，其中包含《最后的生还者：重制版》《战神》和《地平线：零之曙光》。即使计入通胀，该套装折算价格估计也不超过如今的270美元。
PS5独占游戏数量较少也被列为比较背景。需要注意的是，上述结论仅适用于美国市场及相同生命周期节点，不能据此判断PS5与PS4在全球范围内的累计销量关系。

content.v: 经过约一个月测试，一名拥有丰富大型多人在线角色扮演游戏经验的《魔兽世界》新人认为，《魔兽世界：无限》为后来者降低了入坑压力，同时保留了原作的复古质感。该作计划于2026年11月4日推出。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793306833_454881_jpg_r.jpg
这名试玩者曾在《最终幻想XIV》中投入超过5000小时，也体验过数百小时《上古卷轴OL》。不过，大量资料片、世界变化以及错过的宠物和坐骑，一直令她对进入艾泽拉斯感到压力，就连《魔兽世界 经典 怀旧服》也未能让她找到合适的起点。
试玩期间，她选择新增的天裔精灵种族，并以德鲁伊展开冒险。她认为角色创建简单且富有吸引力，探索、任务、组队挑战以及死亡后化为幽灵返回尸体的循环，也能持续推动玩家前进。任务掉落分配较早期版本更加公平，升级和学习技能之间留出的间隔，则有助于新人逐步理解输出与治疗。
《魔兽世界：无限》并未彻底转向现代设计。菜单和界面仍显过时，抬头显示需要玩家自行调整；战斗保留了早期网络游戏的笨拙感，法力管理也较为严苛。试玩者认为，这些设计延续了2004年原作在战斗、对白、卡通动画和老派奇幻氛围上的特点，也让她首次理解《魔兽世界》长期吸引玩家的原因。

content.v: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney近日再次批评Steam，指责其AI使用披露政策带有政治意味，并将Steamworks称为限制跨平台交流的社交“封闭花园”。曾参与《传送门》《半衰期》和《求生之路》的前V社开发者Chet Faliszek随后发布视频，逐项反驳了这些说法。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791923726_805240_jpg_r.jpg
Faliszek认为，Sweeney提出“是否也该要求开发者披露政治立场”的假设并非现实诉求，不能据此否定AI信息披露。玩家只是希望在购买游戏前了解更多信息，这不代表他们缺乏自行判断的能力。
他还提到，Epic旗下数字资产市场Fab同样要求披露AI使用情况。Sweeney此前表示，即使Steam取消这项要求，Fab仍可能出于商业需要继续保留，因此Faliszek认为其公开立场存在矛盾。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793306703_341307_jpg_r.jpg
对于V社阻碍行业发展的批评，Faliszek承认Epic拥有出色的工具和后端方案，但他认为，V社选择给第三方工具及社区方案保留空间，并不等同于扼杀发展。
Faliszek最后以《心灵杀手2》尚未登陆Steam为例，要求Sweeney若强调消费者利益，就应让该作进入Steam。此次交锋围绕平台政策、AI透明度和商店独占展开，V社与Epic均未因此公布新政策。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

others.title: 育碧没有新的《刺客信条》重制版

content.v: 育碧确认，目前没有其他《刺客信条》重制版处于积极开发阶段。《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》上市并取得良好销量后，公司没有立即启动下一部重制作品，而是将现有团队投入系列下一阶段的游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793306622_172171_jpg_r.jpg
育碧表示，相关团队还在开发采用新舞台和新故事、尚未公开的项目。公司仍会探索让旧作回归的机会，但这并不意味着新的重制版已经立项。此次规划公布之际，育碧正经历项目取消、工作室关闭及裁员等重组。
《刺客信条：女巫》目前进展良好，团队正继续围绕其独特构想展开开发，下一次消息预计于2027年公布。多人游戏项目《刺客信条：Invictus》也在推进，近期已有数百名玩家体验早期原型。反馈认为其基础具备潜力，但还需加入更多体现《刺客信条》特色的核心要素，开发团队已据此调整方向，同时保留多人玩法目标。
《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》还将获得最后一次大型更新，内容包括新游戏+、梦魇模式、新奖励、终结技、饰品及更多自定义选项。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Bungie确认，今年的游戏大奖不会公布《 命运 》相关消息，短期内也不会突然公开足以引发轰动的新标志。系列下一阶段内容仍在筹备，但暂时不会在本届TGA亮相。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793306585_224014_jpg_r.jpg
几个月前，Bungie宣布《命运2》走向结束，一度引发玩家对整个系列前景的担忧。此后，工作室在一场大规模线上活动后表示自己“尚未结束《命运》”，并确认系列新篇章正在筹备。
不过，这并不意味着一款新游戏已经接近发布。Bungie此次主动降低近期官宣预期，明确传达的信息是今年TGA没有系列公告，而非《命运》的未来规划已经取消。
目前，Bungie还在推进《命运2》内容回归计划，准备重新加入此前移除的战役、活动及其他内容，首个版本预计到2028年初推出。工作室同时提到信息有限的《命运》“Legacy”项目，预计将在2027年2月提供进一步消息，但尚未确认该项目的具体内容。

content.v: 《 我的世界 》创作者马库斯·“Notch”·佩尔松正在挂牌出售其位于洛杉矶地区的豪宅，要价7000万美元。这一数字与他当年的购入价格相同。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793306403_345669_jpg_r.jpg
2014年，Notch以25亿美元将《我的世界》开发商Mojang出售给微软，随后移居美国。他购买这套贝弗利山豪宅时，曾与Jay-Z和Beyoncé竞价，最终以7000万美元成交。
Notch出售Mojang后没有再推出其他大型游戏，《我的世界》则继续更新并保持广泛流行。微软近期还推出了衍生续作《我的世界：地下城2》，玩家可操控方块角色化身战士或法师，探索类似《暗黑破坏神》的地下城。
此外，《我的世界》电影版全球票房已超过7亿美元，续集也在推进。目前，这次房产挂牌属于Notch的个人动态，与《我的世界》的新内容公告没有直接关系。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2021/05/25/assassins-creed-valhalla-1621913022247.jpg
Assassin's Creed Valhalla launched all the way back in November 2020, but Ubisoft just announced that it's getting its own new game+ mode.

In a blog post, Ubisoft laid out some of its future plans for Assassin's Creed. One of them is a tiny, yet cryptic, update on Assassin's Creed: Codename Hexe . It also announced new game+ mode for Valhalla a mere six years after it first hit consoles.

The new game mode will be coming on November 5, and will include a new, optional progression mode, along with new runes, achievements and a stash system. Ubisoft will also be adding a new crafting material, Mithril, which can be used to upgrade divine gear.

But on top of the NG+ mode, Ubisoft teased that Valhalla will be getting even more updates. In the post, Ubisoft says it will "share full details in the upcoming Patch Notes, along with news regarding current-generation console updates in the coming days." It's not clear what Ubisoft means by "current-generation console updates," but I'd bet on a nice little graphics boost.

While Valhalla does have a PS5 and Xbox Series version, the game hasn't received a PS5 Pro Enhanced glow-up, so I'd guess that's what Ubisoft meant by console updates. But even outside of the Pro, in the years since Valhalla came out, every console has been updated with better upscaling, whether that's QSSR on the base PS5 or FSR 4.1 on the Xbox Series consoles.

Assassin's Creed was well received at launch. When IGN reviewed it, we gave it an 8, with reviewer Brandin Tyrrel saying, "Assassin's Creed Valhalla is a massive, beautiful open-world fueled by brutal living and the dirty work of conquerors. It's a lot buggier than it should be but also impressive on multiple levels."

The new game+ mode isn't the first time Ubisoft has slow-walked updates for Assassin's Creed Valhalla. Players also had to wait nearly two years to get Steam achievements , and the company was still fixing bugs with the game as late as January 2025.

content.v: Geo Seed Games与Luckycalf宣布，开放世界 生存 建造 动作RPG《不朽之树》的Steam愿望单数量已突破10万。当前免费Demo将开放至11月3日上午10时（UTC+8），玩家可在截止前体验多人联机与PvP内容。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793306114_946562_jpg_r.jpg
游戏舞台是遭受“枯败”侵蚀的埃达大陆。玩家将扮演世界树的园丁，收集并附身于不同的 奇幻 生物，借助其能力展开战斗、建造、探索与生存，也可与其他玩家合作建立神殿，争夺土地和资源。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793306115_303377_jpg_r.jpg
本次Demo开放首个区域“翠影谷地”，包含19种生物和4名首领，官方预计游玩时长约为3至5小时。该版本首次支持P2P多人联机和PvP对战，玩家可以借此体验生物附身机制，以及合作与玩家对抗的基本玩法。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793306116_871936_jpg_r.jpg
开发团队表示，正式发售后还计划加入专用服务器和领地争夺等内容。目前正式版发售日期尚未公布，此次免费Demo则设有明确的限时开放窗口。

content.v: 10月29日可以说是大作云集，全天共有20余款游戏正式上线。其中包含《鳄鱼2：戈博斯王国》、两款《地铁》系列游戏的次世代版本升级，还有口碑表现相当出色的《与狼同行 重制版》。今天对XGP来说也是意义重大的一天，共有四款新游戏加入XGP库。期盼已久的《最终幻想7：重制版 Intergrade》终于加入订阅，令不少玩家十分欣喜。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793307454_104184.jpg
XGP 新增四款游戏
《最终幻想7：重制版 Intergrade》(Xbox Series X|S、PC、云游戏)|适用于XGP终极版、PC版、高级版。前神罗战士克劳德降临依靠魔晄能源运转的米德加。经典《最终幻想7》的世界借助顶尖画面技术、全新战斗系统重获新生，本作还包含尤菲・如月的追加冒险篇章。

《植物大战僵尸：重植版》(Xbox Series X|S、PC、云游戏)|适用于XGP终极版、PC版。经典《植物大战僵尸》以高清画质回归，植物与僵尸的原始大战再度上演，画面更加绚丽精彩，游戏加入大量全新秘密与内容等待玩家发掘。
《恐怖蜥蜴 (Terrible Lizards)》(Xbox Series X|S、PC、云游戏)|适用于XGP终极版、PC版。这是一款以66号公路老式游乐园为舞台的恐怖跑酷游戏，乐园地下潜藏着黑暗邪恶的秘密。你必须全速奔跑，闯过危机四伏的地形，揭开 “达尔顿恐龙乐园” 背后的真相，赶紧跑起来!

content.v: 《血源》动画电影已经确定编剧和导演人选。项目公布半年多后，两项关键职位终于落实，团队还规划了更多故事内容，并配齐了继续推动项目所需的相关人员。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261030/1793305419_842415_jpg_r.jpg
制片人Seán“Jacksepticeye”McLoughlin在采访中确认了上述进展，但编剧、导演的身份和具体剧情仍处于保密状态，团队尚未说明何时公开。他表示，自己同时也是原作爱好者，希望尽可能准确地把握这一重要IP，不过满足所有玩家的期待几乎不可能。
McLoughlin认为，《血源》包含大量超现实元素，其中部分画面若采用真人拍摄，不仅难以实现，成本也可能过高，因此动画更适合呈现游戏世界。改编也不会简单复述游戏原有故事，团队更倾向于从既有世界中寻找新的故事，并探索电影与互动游戏在叙事方式上的差异。
团队可能会关注《艾尔登法环》真人电影的处理方式，但McLoughlin表示，两部作品的世界和叙事差异很大，因此不希望受到过多影响。目前《血源》动画电影尚未公布上映时间、完整主创名单及剧情梗概。

items.title: 现代战争 4 的最新地图实际上比玩它的 Z 世代和 Alpha 青少年还要老
items.summary: This map can drink.

content.v: After 23 mainline games, there are far more Call of Duty maps than anyone can reasonably remember. That's why I'm impressed it took just one screenshot for several fans (with back pain, presumably) to clock that an upcoming Modern Warfare 4 map is actually a remake of a map that's over 20 years old.

Backstab, the new 6v6 map arriving on November 6, is a dead ringer for Burgundy , first seen in Call of Duty 2 way back in 2005. That means Backstab is older than the teenagers currently playing Call of Duty—do with that information what you will.
A number of people noticed this around the same time, but I'll credit Reddit user wizward64 for providing helpful visuals.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8ZZjVCYN6Sif9QbnZDDxqc-1920-80.jpg

Apologies to the reader typing "This was a classic, show some respect!", but there's no way I would've noticed the resemblance on my own. I played Call of Duty 2 on the Xbox 360 when it was new, but not all that much multiplayer. I really like the look of the original Burgundy , though: The desaturated green grass and beige brickwork of the French countryside still looks so clean and attractive 21 years later. I'm also now wondering if my favorite Day of Defeat: Source map ( Donner ) snuck in some of these CoD 2 assets, or if all WW2 shooters of this era were riffing on the same Saving Private Ryan scenes.

The layouts are near 1:1, which is neat, though the theming is clearly altered. Burgundy was a WW2 map in France (duh) and Backstab appears to take place in either Russia or North Korea (I think I see Cyrillic script on those signs, so leaning toward the former). Backstab is also snowy, so maybe this town will exist in the eventual Russian chunk of the Hajin DMZ map.

Burgundy was a pretty small map for Call of Duty 2, and I expect it'll feel even smaller at Modern Warfare 4's quicker pace. The map's signature feature was a pair of two-story buildings that overlooked the central courtyard from opposite sides of the battlefield. High windows with usable machine gun emplacements made these buildings important for map control, but those windows will presumably become regular sniper nests in Backstab.

Call of Duty is famous for recycling old maps, but a deep dive into the vault like this feels different from the usual. This isn't Infinity Ward remaking a popular map to please expectant fans like we see with yearly iterations of Nuketown and Shipment, but instead pulling a relatively unknown goodie and refreshing it for a new audience.

The OG Call of Duty studio has apparently been doing this for a while and I didn't notice: As commenters point out in that same Reddit thread, the Modern Warfare 2 (2022) map Taraq was a remake of CoD 1's Neuville and Modern Warfare 2019 map Suldal Harbor was a remake of CoD 1's Harbor . Hey, those maps were pretty good.

items.title: 《PUBG》真人剧集将在 Netflix 上播出，由唐纳德·格洛弗编剧、执导并主演
items.summary: Yep, you read that right: Grammy-award winning music artist and actor Donald Glover is directing and starring

others.title: 由唐纳德·格洛弗主演的 PUBG 电视节目即将登陆 Netflix

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/donald-glover-to-direct-star-in-pubg-series-netflix-1793301671634.jpg
Yep, you read that right: Grammy-award winning music artist and actor Donald Glover is directing and starring in a live-action series adapting Krafton’s battle royale game, PUBG.

PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds is getting the Hollywood treatment with a TV show that will be written, produced, directed by, and starring Donald Glover. His brother, Stephen Glover, is also involved in the project as a co-writer and executive producer.

Other executive producers on the series include Michael Schaefer for NEON TV, Fam Udeorji for Gilga, and Taeseok Jang and Sujin Lee for LV3H. As told in a press release shared with IGN, Krafton — the South Korean gaming conglomerate that owns the franchise — is intent on expanding the IP into “original entertainment content.” LV3H, its entertainment entity, is also helping develop and produce the series.

While making an entire series based on a game where 100 players are dropped onto an island to fight to the death might seem like a bit of a stretch, there’s actually some pretty deep lore that explains the ‘why’ of it all. Admittedly, PUBG was initially created as a purely multiplayer experience, but it has since been fleshed out with an encompassing narrative that can be read on its official website.

The long and short of it is that the Battlegrounds are the brainchild of a billionaire named Sergei Kalimnik, who was the lone survivor of a deadly Soviet attack on the fictional island of Erangel in 1965. After experiencing “17 days of conflict” and watching Soviet officials attempt to dispose of their victims’ corpses, he came up with the brilliant idea of eventually buying the island and recreating his childhood trauma on a grand scale — conscripting 100 people and forcing them to fight until only one remains.

It’s sort of like Squid Game , when you think about it; these experiments expanded to other locales, while audience of shadowy, untouchable elites, much like the VIPs from Netflix’s hit South Korean thriller series, watch from afar. According to the PUBG Universe page, this also somehow ties back to a centuries-old tradition called ‘Magna Venari: The Great Hunt’ that began in the early 15th Century. Described as the “hunting of human prey,” it sought to answer a single question: “Why do some survive when others do not?”
There’s, surprisingly, a lot for Glover to work with here. And given his talents in showbiz ( Atlanta , Community, Swarm), I’m genuinely keen to see what he brings to the table from the PUBG world.

This is the latest video game to score a celebrity-led adaptation following news of Michael B. Jordan’s Battlefield movie . He, alongside Christopher McQuarrie, are reportedly shopping the adaptation around to different studios in hopes of bringing Electronic Arts’ popular military game series to the silver screen. Sony has emerged as a frontrunner to snag the film, though any other news remains nebulous for now.
Image Credits: Mila Gruber/WireImage via Getty Images

items.title: Celeste 和 TowerFall 开发者解释为何游戏突然从 Xbox 下架
items.summary: Celeste and TowerFall have been delisted from Xbox, as the developer has chosen to boycott Microsoft for its i

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/07/18/celeste-1689688002539.jpg
Celeste and TowerFall have been delisted from Xbox, as the developer has chosen to boycott Microsoft for its involvement and investments with the Israeli government.

Developer Maddy Thorson, the mind behind Celeste and TowerFall, confirmed on Bluesky that her team had removed the games from Xbox. They are no longer available to purchase on the platform, which caught some fans by surprise. Thorson stated that she made the decision to remove the titles in support of the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement, which describes itself as a “Palestinian-led movement for freedom, justice and equality.” IGN has asked Microsoft for comment on the situation.

The movement targets companies that are involved with or invested in the Israeli government amidst the ongoing conflict between Israel and Palestine. Celeste and TowerFall are not the first games to drop Xbox as a result of this movement, either. Earlier this fall, the beloved co-op adventure game, Big Walk, chose not to release on Xbox and cited the boycott as its reason . The team noted that, should Microsoft divest from its Israeli ties and be removed from the list of BDS targets, Big Walk would be brought to Xbox.

"We have made the decision not to release Big Walk on Xbox, in accordance with the Palestinian-led BDS (Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions) movement’s call to boycott Microsoft, and their designation of Microsoft Games (and Xbox) as a priority boycott target," said Big Walk developer House House at the time. "If you need help understanding our motives, we would recommend reading about why Microsoft is a BDS priority target, the successes this kind of pressure has already had on Microsoft, and especially, watching this great introductory piece by People Make Games ."
Celeste and TowerFall have both been out for some time, with the latter having been released in 2013 and the former in 2018. Both games remain available for purchase on PlayStation, PC, and Switch.

items.title: 唐纳德·格洛弗 (Donald Glover) 正在为 Netflix 执导一部 PUBG 真人剧集
items.summary: The award-winning writer, actor, and musician is set to write, direct, produce, and star in the show.

content.v: PUBG, the battle royale that lets you wear a frying pan on your ass to keep it from getting shot off, is being made into a live action series for Netflix.

Narrative isn't really PUBG's strong point, but this one might be interesting for one big reason: Donald Glover is set to write, direct, and executive produce the series, and will also star in it. Stephen Glover, Donald's brother and frequent collaborator, is also attached to the project as writer and executive producer.

Glover has won numerous awards over the years for writing, acting, and music (under his stage name Childish Gambino), to the point that "list of awards and nominations received by Donald Glover" has its own remarkably lengthy Wikipedia page . Highlights include two Primetime Emmy awards, two Golden Globes, five Grammy Awards, two Peabody Awards, and five Writers Guild of America Awards.

The upside of PUBG not having a strong pre-existing story like, say, Halo or Fallout is that it affords creators the opportunity to do their own thing, and as I said, that could be very interesting indeed with Glover at the helm. His 2018 music video for This Is America , built around themes of racism and gun violence in the US, was critically acclaimed and won multiple awards, but also attracted considerable controversy over its violent content. More recently, his Mr. & Mrs. Smith series on Amazon Prime, which premiered in 2024, drew 16 Primetime Emmy nominations for its first season, including "Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series" for Glover himself.
No other details about the upcoming PUBG show on Netflix were announced, but even so, I'm definitely curious about this one and looking forward to learning more.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远不会有死服务器
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever will avoid repeating WoW Classic's mistakes and will have tools to prevent "dead" o

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever will avoid repeating WoW Classic's mistakes and will have tools to prevent "dead" or "unsustainable" server rulesets, Blizzard said.

In the past, various WoW Classic servers became "dead" over time, as players either stopped playing or transferred to other servers. Those massive drops in population had major ramifications for players left on the server being unable to find groups for raids or dungeons, as well as for the server's economy and auction house. In some extreme cases, Blizzard gave away free character transfers so players could leave their "dead" servers behind.

While Forever is going a different route with what are essentially mega servers tailored around specific rulesets, some players might still have anxiety when it comes to picking a ruleset that will be a healthy place to play long-term.

In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever podcast , Blizzard said it has tools it can use if a ruleset's population becomes "unsustainable." Senior game designer Josh Greenfield gave the example of Forever's separate RP and (newly added) RP-PvP server rulesets. He said there were initially concerns about splitting up the RP community, fearing that one or both of the rulesets wouldn't be able to stand the test of time. He said Blizzard now believes "it will be fine," but does have options should the worst happen.

"If someday down the line, if something happens and one or both of those populations can't quite sustain themselves, we have options if we do need to say link up their auction houses or allow them to group for instanced content," Greenfield said.

Greenfield said it's not something Blizzard will jump to unless absolutely necessary and that it's committed to its current separate-ruleset path. Blizzard debated the idea of rulesets during Forever's development and discussed letting players from different rulesets group together for instanced content or combining auction houses.

However, it landed on wanting to maintain distinct communities, in part because of the differences in server economies when it comes to PvE and PvP rulesets, with Greenfield using an example of how it's easier to farm for gold and items on a PvE server. That in turn opened up debates on whether these cross-ruleset players would be able to trade items with one another and the need for other restrictions.

"Ultimately, these are different mindsets, these are different rulesets," Greenfield said the team decided. "Let's keep them separate for now. That is a part of original WoW that we don't want to just throw out completely. But I think the tech is set up in such a way that if we ever did really feel like we needed to make a change, we could do so."

He said those options are merely "levers we can pull if we need to" and that it's important for Blizzard to "stay flexible." That's good news, and will likely give players worried about choosing the wrong ruleset some relief.

Blizzard is keeping busy in the handful of days left before Forever's launch. It previously detailed how it's making improvements to Forever's divisive layering system in time for release, and announced major changes to racial abilities .

In a first for WoW, Forever will be fully playable on a controller . WoW executive producer and vice president Holly Longdale recently said Forever's controller support is a step towards WoW being playable "wherever you want" and "on whatever you want."
WoW: Forever arrives November 4. If you want to be ready for launch day, you can technically make up to three WoW: Forever characters right now .

items.title: Artist With Music In GTA 6 Had No Idea About Any Of That
items.summary: Cliff Richard is among the numerous famous artists who are lending their music to Rockstar's GTA 6 , with Rich

content.v: Cliff Richard is among the numerous famous artists who are lending their music to Rockstar's GTA 6 , with Richard's classic tune "Devil Woman" appearing in the Netflix Extended Look . Richard, 86, didn't know about any of that, however, or that GTA 6 is a game and not a TV show.

Speaking to The Times ( via Dexerto ), Richard said of the partnership with Rockstar for GTA 6: "I was told this happened!" He said his nephew's sons told him about it. "They didn't realize I could sing like that," he said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Lucia_Caminos_08_b9b403.jpg?w=636
Richard was eventually made aware of GTA 6, but the singer doesn't know what that is. “The show is a game show, isn’t it, really? One of the biggest on TV?” he asked.
"Devil Woman" was originally released in 1976, so it's now 50 years old. Richard said he's pretty jazzed about the fact that young people will hear his music.
“People will no longer just say, ‘Oh, Cliff Richard is from the past,’” he said. “Because I am, but that past is what makes everything what it is today."
It was reported that Spotify streams of "Devil Woman" surged massively following the Netflix Extended Look in August.

For more on the music of GTA 6, be sure to check out GameSpot's rundown of all the songs in the game. The game's official score by Justice is releasing on December 11 , and it will be available to stream and buy on physical media. The same cannot be said for the game itself, which is a digital exclusive . The game will be sold at retailers, but there is no disc: just a code in a box.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and the game's file size is gargantuan.

content.v: Krafton and Netflix today announced a live-action TV show based on PUBG, and it will star Emmy-winner Donald Glover. In fact, Glover will not only star, but also direct, write, and executive produce the show, along with his brother, Stephen Glover, as writer and executive producer.
That's all Krafton had to say in its announcement, so it sounds like early days for the PUBG series. A PUBG animated series is on the way, too, from Castlevania's Adi Shankar.
Donald Glover is no stranger to video games, as he voiced Yoshi in The Super Mario Galaxy Movie this year . He also partnered with Ubisoft for a Far Cry 4 trailer.
Krafton has maintained that it sees PUBG not just as a game, but a connected universe, so it's only fitting that the company would get into TV.

PUBG is a battle royale game where players duke it out to be the last person or team standing. The game remains immensely popular, boasting more than 785,000 peak concurrent users on Steam alone today.

items.title: 《Apex 英雄》更新让你双持僚机，带回生命线复活护盾
items.summary: Some people are absolutely cracked with the Wingman. And now they’ll be able to use two at once. Cipher introd

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/apexlegendsthumb-1793287635389.png

Apex Legends: Cipher is coming on November 3 and it’s bringing a new weapon style that makes me scared. The Wingman is a semi-automatic revolver that utilizes Sniper Ammo, and it’s been the bane of my existence since Apex Legends launched.
Some people are absolutely cracked with the Wingman. And now they’ll be able to use two at once. Cipher introduces Akimbo Wingman, which trades off some of the accuracy for big(ger) damage.

The Wingman has wavered a bit in recent seasons and sits as the 19th most effective weapon in DPS terms, but it’s still deadly in accurate hands, across basically any distance. It’s two-to-four headshots for a Wingman kill depending on the armor they’re wearing, which is what makes it so deadly in the right hands.

The Akimbo Wingman will push players in closer to barrel stuff your face. It’s going to be interesting to see where the weapon ends up with this new option — famously, the Akimbo Mozambique was famously nerfed quickly after it went from a barely used gun to the game’s dominant weapon.

On top of the dual revolvers, Crypto is getting a rework dubbed Crypto Rewired, which sees him role switch from a drone-camping git to a push-forward intel machine. His Surveillance Drone now runs on batteries instead of a cooldown, meaning it can be picked up and redeployed without a long wait, along with a new Sentry Mode that tags enemies on sight. On top of that, his EMP Ultimate can now be deployed with the press of a button.

Cipher also introduces Strongholds, which Respawn is calling the “evolution of care packages.” To access them you have to raid the Stronghold to haul out crate weapons, corrupted attachments, and EVO shield boosts for the squad. It’s a timely endeavour, and nearby enemies will hear the alarm.

Revenant and Lifeline are also getting buffs. For Rev, there’s a shorter Ult cooldown and faster Tactical, as well as new upgrades that allow him to extend his Ult with each knock. Another upgrade lets him Silence players with Shadow Pounce.
Lifeline is getting a reduced drone cooldown, self-healing while gliding, an Ult cooldown reduction, and improved flight mobility. On top of that, Respawn is bringing back her revive shield.
Elsewhere there are new Ranked updates, with Legend Bans in Diamond lobbies and above. Players vote to ban certain Legends, and the ones with the most votes can’t be picked for the match.
Apex Legends: Cipher launches November 3.

items.title: Ubisoft Is Pumping The Brakes On Assassin’s Creed Remakes For Now
items.summary: What's next for the Assassin's Creed franchise? Following the successful launch of Assassin's Creed Black Flag

content.v: What's next for the Assassin's Creed franchise? Following the successful launch of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced earlier this--which sold very well--you'd imagine that Ubisoft would be looking to fast-track another remake while it continues work on future titles. That's not the case, as Ubisoft dropped a new update on all things Assassin's Creed, including confirmation that it's not currently working on any remakes.

"One thing we want to be transparent about today is that we currently have no other Assassin's Creed remake actively in development," Ubisoft wrote . "Our teams are already focused on the next chapter of Assassin's Creed titles, including projects you haven't heard about yet, featuring new settings and stories."

While you shouldn't expect another Assassin's Creed remake anytime soon, Ubisoft added that it will still keep "exploring opportunities" to bring older titles back. As for future projects, Ubisoft said that it's making "good progress" on its darker Assassin's Creed experience, Codename Hexe . An update on it will arrive in 2027, and Ubisoft added that the team remains focused on delivering a "unique vision" at the heart of this project. The other in-development title, Codename Invictus, is also taking shape behind the scenes. This will be a multiplayer Assassin's Creed game, and Ubisoft says hundreds of players recently got to go hands-on with an early prototype.

"One piece of feedback came through clearly though: Players saw great potential in the foundations but wanted more of the pillars that define Assassin's Creed. The team spent the past months acting on it, and Invictus is now evolving in an exciting direction that better reflects those pillars while staying true to its multiplayer ambitions," Ubisoft wrote.

For current games, Black Flag Resynced players can download one final major update. This adds New Game Plus, Nightmare Mode, new rewards, finishers, trinkets, and additional customization options to the Black Flag remake. Assassin's Creed Valhalla players aren't being left out in the cold either, as New Game Plus is being added to the Viking saga on November 5. A heavily requested feature for this particular Assassin's Creed game, the update will also add an optional progression mode where Gear, Runes, and Masteries all contribute to Eivor's overall power ranking. Players can also earn new gear and a Master Assassin outfit inspired by Naoe's look in Assassin's Creed Shadows; a new Mithril resource is being added, and you can upgrade your gear to a new "Divine" level.

While the news is good for Assassin's Creed fans, it comes amid restructuring at Ubisoft that has led to several canceled games, shut-down studios, and layoffs. Trials developer RedLynx is on the chopping block , while 72 people from Ubisoft Singapore--the studio behind Skull & Bones--were recently laid off.

items.title: 《命运 2》出库更新：听起来原版《命运》终于要登陆 PC 了
items.summary: The actual restoration of vaulting Destiny 2 content is still a long way off, but Bungie has big plans for the

content.v: Bungie shocked the world (or at least, it shocked the world's Destiny fans) when it un-canceled Destiny 2 in September, saying the game "is foundational to Bungie’s future" and promising to restore vaulted content and "return Destiny to its original promise." In a community update shared today, the studio revealed more about that process, and one standout point is that it sure sounds like the original Destiny is finally coming to PC.

The update begins with a broad overview of what led up to the unvaulting announcement and what's happened since, a broad roadmap that breaks down into three sections—First Pass, Stretch Goals, and stuff that's probably not going to happen "for technical and/or strategic reasons"—and a progress bar:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oxMkLMNfdVtecuZVEkdUT5-1920-80.jpg

It's worth noting up front that while things have been happening fairly quickly so far, the actual Great Unvaultening is still a long way off. The pre-production process is now underway and expected to run until January or February of 2027, and "from that point we expect full production will be about 12 months to fully complete the porting process," Bungie head of product Josh Deane said. That puts it in early 2028—assuming things go according to plan.

Deane then touched on what comes after that, referencing his comment in September that Bungie is "not done with Destiny." With caveats that "some things are subject to change in success or failure," he said that Bungie is "marching forward with a phased plan for Destiny’s future that celebrates our legacy and propels us into a new, far green country." To that end, he cited three "anchors" for players to watch for:
Destiny 2 “Celebration’’ [Expect a new February Progress bar]
Destiny ‘Legacy’ [Expect a new February Progress bar]
Redacted [TBD]

The second point is the one that caught our interest. Destiny 2 was (and, some PC Gamer folks would argue, still is) huge on PC, but the original game never came our way: More than a decade after it launched, it remains exclusive to consoles.

Proclaiming that "the whole experience needs to be served to you all where you play today" pretty strongly suggests to me that's going to change, and that's a big deal: Destiny 2's Final Shape expansion brought an end to the 10-year Light and Darkness saga in 2024, but a lot of us never got to experience how it actually started, and I'd bet that having the opportunity to do so would bring a lot of lapsed players (myself included) back to see what's cooking.

Deane concluded by saying that this is a major undertaking and not one that will be finished quickly. "It’s important to know that this is a true reset moment for Bungie, Marathon, and Destiny. We also know time isn’t our friend; we’re playing from behind with the cards we have and I’m sure we’ll have to take more punches and make some hard decisions along the way," he said.

"Knowing we are early in incubating our future and actively working on projects to bridge us to that new home, don’t expect us to make a Destiny announcement at the TGA’s this year, or to randomly drop a logo that sets the world on fire right away.
"We get there when we get there."

items.title: WoW: Forever Controller Support Is A First Step To Playing The MMO On “Whatever You Want”
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever will launch with full controller support, a first for the various versions of Blizz

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever will launch with full controller support, a first for the various versions of Blizzard's longrunning PC-exclusive MMORPG. According to Blizzard, the option to play on controller is the "first leg of a journey" to make WoW playable "on whatever you want."

Speaking to GamesRadar , WoW executive producer and vice president Holly Longdale said Blizzard's goal is to eventually have WoW playable "wherever you want, and, at some point, on whatever you want."

The first step on that road, however, is ensuring controller support works really well. Blizzard is using the launch of Forever on November 4, the latest version of its MMO that reimagines the game's classic world and gameplay with new content and features, as a starting point.
"Looking at where things are going when we hear about Project Helix [the codename for Xbox's next console], et cetera, I think platforms will be a bit more ubiquitous," Longdale said.
She continued: "I think just doing some of the work we're doing on gamepad [support] is going to give players a lot of flexibility that I think goes beyond consoles."

Having gone hands-on with Forever's controller support during BlizzCon 2026, I can say it works surprisingly well for a game that has been played almost exclusively with mouse and keyboard for 22 years. While modern WoW has added some barebones controller options in recent years, Forever's implementation is far superior, working seamlessly without the need for player-made addons like ConsolePort to make it usable.

You have a surprisingly number of keybinds available at your fingertips (28, to be exact), making combat and interacting with quest NPCs a breeze. Inventory management and navigating menus is a little more cumbersome, but it does feel like a decent tradeoff for being able to play on a controller or a handheld, like the Xbox ROG Ally X.
When WoW might be playable on something other than a PC remains to be seen, though Blizzard has made clear that if it were making a console version, it wouldn't exactly be a secret .

But that doesn't mean WoW on consoles is still years away. Xbox's next console, Project Helix , is rumored to be a hybrid device capable of playing console and PC games, meaning WoW would likely be playable on it. According to a recent report, Project Helix is aiming for a 2028 release, may include a handheld component, and could possibly cost between $1,200 and $1,800 if Microsoft doesn't subsidize it.

In the meantime, Blizzard is plenty busy getting ready for Forever's launch, including reworking racial abilities and making improvements to the game's divisive layering system . If you bought the MMO's new optional playable race, the Skyborne, you can technically make your WoW: Forever character right now ahead of launch day. WoW: Forever launches November 4.

items.title: 育碧分享神秘刺客信条代号 Hexe 更新
items.summary: Assassin's Creed Codename Hexe was announced all the way back in 2022, but aside from a spooky teaser, we stil

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2022/09/10/hexe-1662841484669.jpg

Assassin's Creed Codename Hexe was announced all the way back in 2022, but aside from a spooky teaser, we still don't know much about it. In a new blog post, Ubisoft has shared a cryptic clue that may shed some light on the project — if you're able to decode it, that is.

In the blog post , Ubisoft laid out its vision for the future of Assassin's Creed, and, of course, Codename Hexe is a big part of that future. At first glance, the update on the upcoming game is vague; the blog post simply says, "We're making steady progress on this darker Assassin's Creed experience, though there is still work ahead of us. We know the wait has been long, and we're grateful for your patience and continued enthusiasm for the project."

But it seems like more concrete updates will be coming next year, with the post continuing, "The team remains focused on delivering the unique vision at the heart of this project, and we'll share our next major update in 2027 ." That's pretty much all the information about Hexe that Ubisoft has shared, so it seems like we'll have to wait until next year to get some concrete information about the game.

Ubisoft did include a little clue for dedicated players with a knack for decyphering coded messages, though. After the Codename Hexe entry, Ubisoft simply writes: "ZKLWAVN MBEXNK ULYCNJ... LWY01... I#########F // QNTMAKHX TWTEMZL. YSIZKQ AADSWX NFAAMPHP.//" I'm not sure what that means, if anything, but I'm sure that fans will be able to decode it eventually.

Whatever it ends up being called, Assassin's Creed Codename Hexe is likely to be the first mainline Assassin's Creed game after 2025's Assassin's Creed Shadows. Other than the spooky theme of its only teaser, we don't know much about when it's going to take place, but I'd imagine that witchcraft is going to be a major theme.

We know little else about the game so far. Earlier this year, a leaker suggested a popular Assassin's Creed character would be returning. We've also heard that the game has been reworked internally to change some of its more magical elements. It has also gone through some staffing shakeups earlier this year, after the game director and creative director left the project.

items.title: 2023 年，一位匿名模组制作者发布了十年来最好的恐怖游戏之一，但他们仍然没有打破角色
items.summary: MyHouse.wad barrages players with horrible things they've never experienced in a game before.

content.v: For a lot of people, the appeal of horror is being surprised and disturbed by something they've never seen before. In recent years, I've sourced this rare feeling from movies like Obsession, where the gender dynamics of that story made it feel a bit dangerous, or Speak No Evil, which has one of the most shocking and nihilistic endings that I can recall. I even find that freshness in a modern classic like Pearl, which isn't really scary, but contrasts a technicolour old Hollywood style with a singularly unsettling Mia Goth performance to great effect.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/N5WXFQSCttV6Am7CopwTzd-1920-80.png
This article is brought to you by No More Room in Hell 2 .

Fear of the unknown is more valuable to me as a viewer than seeing a really good version of something I've experienced before. In games, it's largely the same—I crave new places and themes above all else. It's why Silent Hill: Townfall, Mouthwashing, Dredge, Silent Hill f, and Still Wakes The Deep all succeeded for me. They're all set in locations or timeframes I've never seen anywhere else in games. I step into those worlds not knowing exactly what I'm going to find, and come out the other side feeling exhilarated in a profoundly nasty way. That's horror, baby.

From this decade, however, nothing in the horror genre has upended my expectations like MyHouse.wad. Everyone who plays this Doom 2 map seems to have the same experience: they know there's something weird about this mod set in a seemingly normal suburban home, but they spiral once they start playing it and realise how many secrets are impossibly embedded within its walls. They then become obsessed with trying to understand exactly how the house works. I consider it a modern horror classic because it's able to take players on this ride.

If you missed its release in 2023, the 'backstory' behind MyHouse.wad is that its creator had recently lost an important friend. Among his friend's belongings was a floppy disc containing an incomplete Doom map recreation of his parents' house. Since they both shared an interest in Doom mapping back in the '00s, the creator decided to honour his friend's memory by finishing his work. Except, of course, this story is all fiction, and the Doom map in question turns out to be a hellish labyrinth disguised as a lovely home. Its real creator? Still officially unknown.
MyHouse.wad is relentlessly tense, and punctuated by a series of 'WTF' moments that keep you wondering what evil thing you've downloaded.

On the first run through MyHouse.wad, it does indeed look like a normal suburban house, albeit one filled with Doom monsters. After killing the patrolling enemies, you exit the house, look in from the outside, and realise it's somehow filled with monsters again. You go inside to gun them down and learn the house has subtly changed: new doors appear, leading to rooms that weren't there before and architecturally impossible spaces. Key visual details have been altered. Crucially, too, the sound design begins messing with your head, resetting and then distorting Doom 2's classic Running From Evil music, or playing the Discord notification sound as a jump scare. No matter where you go, too, the general shape of the environment somehow still looks exactly like the house…
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VpYkf5XgMFtgBcv3ju5cT-1920-80.png

The unsettling details of the spaces you're exploring just pile up—MyHouse.wad is relentlessly tense, and punctuated by a series of 'WTF' moments that keep you wondering what evil thing you've downloaded. There's no question that the choice of a simple family home as the backdrop contributes to how disturbing it is.
Bless this mess
MyHouse.wad is just as mischievous as it is scary.

The first thing that very online people will tell you about this mod is that it's inspired by House of Leaves, an experimental novel by Mark Z. Danielewski (which has also been cited as an influence on Remedy's Alan Wake and Control). The mod shares the premise of a house that's larger on the inside than it seems from the outside, with the interior undergoing constant bizarre changes. There are several direct references to specific details from the book.

But while reading House of Leaves these days feels like work—I got the distinct impression I'd have appreciated its experimental structure and overwrought style much more if I'd read it at 21, rather than my late 30s—MyHouse.wad is just as mischievous as it is scary.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3ceUKRMx29vUBHrJ7wKra-1920-80.png

I feel its anonymous creator chuckling darkly at me as I see the house refill with monsters, or when I shoot a horrible giant fish guarding a swimming pool and see it explode into tinier evil fish that are much harder to kill. The creator is definitely laughing at me as I fight an evil version of Shrek outside a nursery. While the story of the mod gestures at darker themes, it's almost like the creator is playing a series of pranks on you, subverting your expectations of Doom as they go (illustrated by John Romero himself streaming it multiple times and frequently stopping to admire its tricks).

My relationship with MyHouse.wad is similar to how I felt about Kojima Productions' PT . It's not something I necessarily play for its mechanics—even though it's still Doom, of course. You're more focused on unpicking the 'how did they do that?' factor of its impossible architecture, the nightmarish logic of how the different areas link together or why its more novel monsters are even there. It's one giant mystery with a load of little mysteries buried inside it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nUQVobyWzyVY3jZoT8GTK-1920-80.png

Another thing it has in common with PT is how scant details are on its creation, which feeds into the overall legend surrounding it. As mentioned, we still don't officially know who made MyHouse.wad—the creepypasta-style files in the mod's Google Drive folder don't give anything away. Its credited creator is Steven Nelson, AKA Veddge, but that's just a pseudonym. Veddge's Doomworld account was active until 2006, at which point they took a hiatus until they started posting again in 2022. That too feeds into the wad's myth. Veddge has not posted once since the mod was released in 2023, either.
It's packed with the kind of moments or clever twists that would become iconic if they featured in full games.

I'm almost too vain to accept the idea that someone could create something this good then disappear into the wilderness without taking credit for it. But this confidential origin story is a key part of MyHouse.wad's creative identity. Anyone with a search engine and a spare hour can piece together who the creator almost certainly is (and in-game credits shed light on who else contributed to the project), but I wouldn't give that much thought. The intention behind the mod's creation is to blur fiction and reality in this way that enhances the experience. Let the mystery be.
House secrets

Replaying it now, what is staggering about MyHouse.wad is that it's packed with the kind of moments or clever twists that would become iconic if they featured in full games. People still talk about Psycho Mantis reading your PlayStation memory card in Metal Gear Solid almost three decades later. But this mod has maybe four or five moments that evoked a similar 'no way…' response from me as a player, all happening inside this single map.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R4GVTEjTr9YpxSzJsFY5d-1920-80.png

items.title: 据报道，英伟达首席执行官曾被中国间谍盯上，此前涉嫌走私人工智能芯片
items.summary: Nvidia says Huang would've only spoken about "ordinary business information" with a data center exec anyways.

content.v: Jensen Huang, Nvidia's CEO and one of AI's most important people, was reportedly targeted by a data centre executive working as a spy for the Chinese government, a new report suggests.

According to the New York Times , citing undisclosed sources that were briefed on the matter, Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was being watched by US agencies due to suspicion of involvement in data centre chip smuggling from Singapore. During that surveillance, the officials are said to have determined that Alice Huang was acting as an intelligence asset.

Moreover, those officials are also said to have determined that Alice Huang had a close relationship with Jensen Huang (no relation). The NYT suggests that officials were concerned that Alice Huang may have been able to extract information from this relationship that would be useful to the Chinese state—what with Nvidia being pivotal to America's AI efforts.

It's said that Jensen Huang had, at the time, not been briefed on the threat of foreign intelligence services. It was later implied Nvidia was not briefed on Alice Huang, either. The Nvidia CEO has a close relationship with US president Donald Trump, and has travelled with the US president to China and was more recently called by the president while on stage at an AI event .

The US has approved the sale of some AI chips to China, though they are not the cutting-edge Blackwell chips that US firms have access to—providing they pay a pretty penny, anyways. China had been blocking some of these chips on its side, but recent reports suggest older Nvidia H200 cards are reaching China in small amounts .

As it stands, the White House, CIA, and NSA have all declined to comment to the NYT. Who knew what, and when, is still up in the air. Even Alice Huang's status with the data centre company that was under scrutiny for chip smuggling, Megaspeed, is not currently clear.

Nvidia has also pushed back on a few of the claims made in the NYT report. The company says that claims Megaspeed had any involvement in chip smuggling were debunked last year in a statement to CNBC .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hYpyAaA3sEs774SXS6x5mW-1920-80.jpg
"The diversion allegations against this regional cloud were thoroughly investigated and debunked last year,” says spokesperson John Rizzo.
Rizzo also pushed back on Huang's relationship with Alice Huang being anything exceptional to the NYT.
“Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year.”

He also added that Nvidia believes the US government would have made it known had there been any threat to American industry, and that Megaspeed would have received "ordinary business information" and not trade secrets; "zero information relevant to national security."

items.title: 极限竞速赛车运动总监兼 Turn 10 老板 Dan Greenawalt 在任职 27 年后从微软退休
items.summary: Dan Greenawalt, a 27-year Microsoft employee who helped build Turn 10 Studios from scratch and directed eight

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/forzamotorsport-2023-blog-1696401871647-1793294503886.jpg

Dan Greenawalt, a 27-year Microsoft employee who helped build Turn 10 Studios from scratch and directed eight Forza Motorsport games spanning all four Xbox console generations, is retiring from Microsoft, according to a new report.

The Verge's Tom Warren reports that he's seen an internal memo that confirms Greenawalt's departure. “Dan Greenawalt has decided that this is the right time for him to retire from Microsoft,” said Playground Games studio head Trevor Williams. Playground, who develops the Forza Horizon franchise, was merged with Greenawalt's Turn 10 last month as part of Xbox's ongoing " reset ."

Williams added, in part, "It’s hard to overstate Dan’s impact over the past 27 years. From shipping Project Gotham Racing on the original Xbox in 2001 to leading the creation of Forza, founding Turn 10 Studios and appearing so many times on our E3 stage, usually making a dramatic entrance with a supercar in tow."

Unfortunately, it looks as though 2023's Forza Motorsport, which was meant to be a platform of sorts that would be evolved and added onto, might be the last Motorsport game for the foreseeable future, if ever, after layoffs hit Turn 10 last year and reportedly relegated the remaining team to support duty on the highly profitable Forza Horizon. Motorsport will not be getting any more new content .
Greenawalt's Forza Motorsport series consistently earned critical acclaim, with all eight games scoring an 8 out of 10 or higher at IGN.

items.title: 你们都猜到了《上古卷轴 6》的名字，现在这是游戏的设置 – 报告
items.summary: After eight years , Xbox is reportedly preparing to reintroduce The Elder Scrolls VI to the world. And this ti

content.v: After eight years , Xbox is reportedly preparing to reintroduce The Elder Scrolls VI to the world. And this time, the game will apparently get an official subtitle: Sentinel. According to The Verge , Bethesda could reveal the full name next month in celebration of Skyrim's 15th anniversary. That's not all, though.

The report states that Hammerfell will serve as the setting for Sentinel. It's a massive region that's southwest of Skyrim and probably best known for being playable in The Elder Scrolls Online . As for the narrative, the RPG "will be the first game about the history of the Elder Scrolls," per The Verge. That means discovering "the secrets of these mysterious ancient artifacts" in Sentinel.

It's unknown how much Bethesda will showcase, if the re-reveal does in fact happen in November. However, the report states that gameplay demonstrations are taking place, following up Xbox CEO Asha Sharma saying she saw the game in August. At that time, Sharma teased The Elder Scrolls VI's subtitle, and fans correctly figured out it's Sentinel --at least reportedly right now. She also noted that the game's "scale and grandeur are incredible."

Earlier this year, Skyrim director Todd Howard expressed that he knows his team at Bethesda needs "to get it right" with The Elder Scrolls VI . The majority of people at Bethesda Game Studios are working on the RPG currently.
As for whether The Elder Scrolls 6 could be an Xbox console exclusive , Sharma is playing coy about that possibility. What we do know is that Bethesda has a new logo .

items.title: 谷歌股价暴跌 5000 亿美元，称“我们对自己的发展轨迹感到非常满意”
items.summary: More than a little nibble.

content.v: Even during a good financial year, a big tech investor is seemingly never satisfied. Case in point, while Google Search grew by 12% year-over-year and made $63.3 billion this past quarter, parent company Alphabet's share price took a pretty spectacular tumble.

Despite making an amount of money the mere thought of which sucks the air right out of my lungs, Search's revenue this quarter was actually below Wall Street's expectations. As a result, Alphabet's shares are down 13% and $500 billion has been wiped from its market value (via The Financial Times ).

The share price is continuing to fluctuate and, according to CNBC , it could be the worst post-earnings call decline ever. This follows $1 trillion worth of air escaping from the AI party balloon earlier this month , due to anxious investors widely selling off stock. So, how did Alphabet get its ABC's so wrong? Long story short, Google's own AI features may be eating into its Search revenue.

This is despite Search apparently seeing the fastest year-over-year query growth rate in half a decade. During Alphabet's most recent earnings call , Google's senior vice president and chief business officer Philipp Schindler was asked to explain this 'disconnect'.

"It's worth noting that the strong growth in AI Mode queries had an impact because of the lower monetization we were seeing in AI Mode," Schindler says. "To be clear, we feel very good about our trajectory here. Our ad experiments have shown promising results, and we're now scaling ads within both AI Overviews and AI Mode to more users and more queries, including, as I mentioned, international markets and multiturn ads in the US."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jXqdZNznwAgMFVjiRtMsaj-1920-80.png

In other words, yes, AI Mode is eating Search's lunch but Google is hoping to scale up its kitchen production in order to keep both of its babies fed. Or something like that—the metaphor got away from me in the middle there.

Anyway, these financial results only serve to add fuel to the fire of investor fear that Google Search is getting singed by the likes of ChatGPT. I mean, compare and contrast the amount of ads you see on the first page of Google results against what you typically see from an LLM chatbot. As Google tells it, more ads are likely coming to AI Overviews and AI Mode in the near future to remedy its 'disconnect.'

On top of what investors are seeing as financial underperformance, Google is also knee deep in negative cash flow. Initial projections suggested this wouldn't venture into the red beyond $3.5 billion, but Google was actually looking at minus $9.1 billion at the end of September. This is apparently only the second quarter in which Google has reported negative cash flow since it went public back in 2004.

Having spent $51.3 billion on AI in the last quarter alone, such a plunge is perhaps unsurprising. The company intends to spend even more in the future, having apparently committed itself to data centre and related purchases in excess of $1 trillion—despite investors growing increasingly anxious about whether a return on AI investment will ever fully materialise.

items.title: 《刺客信条》两款新作开发中 暂无其他重制版项目
items.summary: 《刺客信条》官方今日发布了秋季更新公告，向玩家分享了系列近期的工作进展与未来规划。在本次公告中，官方重点介绍了目前正在开发…

content.v: 《刺客信条》官方今日发布了秋季更新公告，向玩家分享了系列近期的工作进展与未来规划。在本次公告中，官方重点介绍了目前正在开发中的两款全新系列作品，并对未来的重制版计划作出了明确回应。
视频：
针对开发中的新游戏，官方重点提及了代号为“Hexe”和“Invictus”的两个项目。
《刺客信条》代号Hexe被官方定义为一款风格更加黑暗的作品。目前该作正稳步开发中，但前方仍有大量工作要完成。开发团队表示将专注于实现这款作品的独特核心愿景，并确认将于2027年分享关于本作的下一波重大更新，同时感谢玩家一直以来的耐心与不减的热情。

另一款正在开发的代号Invictus是一项野心勃勃的多人游戏项目。此前，已有数百名玩家参与了其内部测试。玩家对PvP多人游戏模式的回归反应相当正面，尤其喜欢地图的跑酷设计、垂直空间、团队合作玩法，以及能够扮演系列中不同角色的设定。不过，玩家也反馈希望看到更多《刺客信条》系列的核心要素。对此，开发团队在过去几个月里积极回应，目前Invictus正朝着令人振奋的新方向发展，在保留多人游戏目标的同时，更充分体现系列特色。官方也提醒，由于游戏仍在开发中，网传的部分信息可能并不完整或已过时。
除了新作，官方也更新了已发售游戏的动态：《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》已推出最后一次大型更新；而玩家突破4000万的《刺客信条：英灵殿》也将于11月5日推出玩家期待已久的“新游戏+”模式。
最后，官方明确表示，目前没有其他《刺客信条》重制版正在开发中。开发团队的重心已放在系列接下来的新篇章上（包括尚未公开的全新时代背景与故事），但官方也强调，未来仍会持续探索让旧作回归玩家视野的机会。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/30/small_202610300104086511.png
此外，Netflix《刺客信条》真人版影集在罗马的拍摄已进入尾声，官方还预告了2027年将迎来系列20周年，届时将有一整年的精彩活动等待玩家。

items.summary: A new report claims that the next Elder Scrolls game will be titled The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel, along with

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/11/tes6-1786479096622.jpg
A new report claims the next Elder Scrolls game will be titled The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel , along with new story details.

According to The Verge , The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is the title of the highly-anticipated follow-up to Bethesda's Skyrim. This title has been rumored for some time now , but The Verge is putting extra weight behind it. According to the outlet, the game's title could be formally announced as soon as next month, possibly aligned with either Skyrim's 15th anniversary or Xbox's 25th anniversary. The game will reportedly take place in Hammerfell and dive into the history of the titular artifacts, allowing players to discover their secrets firsthand for the first time.

All of this is pretty exciting and shows that the game is likely getting closer to release. While we're not quite sure when to expect The Elder Scrolls 6, it wouldn't be surprising if we hear more details next year ahead of a 2028 release. However, Bethesda does like to wait until its games are close to the finish line to really lay it all out there, so we may be waiting a while before we get raw gameplay.

The road to The Elder Scrolls 6 has been quite long, as Bethesda announced the game back in 2018. At that stage, the game was still in the very, very early stages of pre-production. It may not have even really been anything more than a concept at that point, since Bethesda was full steam ahead on Starfield, which wouldn't release for another five years from that point. Since shipping Starfield, The Elder Scrolls 6 has become a massive priority and the studio's focus going forward.

Although there is a lot happening in and around Bethesda with future Fallout games, re-releases, and Starfield updates, The Elder Scrolls 6 seems to be taking the bulk of the developer's focus. The only question now is: will it all be worth the long wait?
